title: Surreal AI Official Music Video - Quiet Rebellion - Kelly Boesch | 4K
description:
Sometimes the most powerful thing you can do is refuse to change your ink to fit someone else’s page. These lyrics are about finding the grace in the strange. Stay liquid in a world made of stone. It's called 'Quiet Rebellion'. 

The visuals were made using Midjourney and animated using VEO3. Lyrics written by me, Kelly Boesch. Music created under my creative direction with assistance from Suno.

#ai #aiart #aivideo #music #surreal

top_comments.text:
I'm unraveling the thoughts from the dream I forgot 
Tying my spirit in a delicate knot 
The wallpaper peels in a floral decay  
I'm finding the colors the sun threw away.
I am the liquid form 
in a world made of stone.  
I melted harsh words 
till wilt, dry and prune.

Let the rhythm be wide 
and the logic be thin.
I'm living in the spaces
where the secrets begin.
It's a quiet rebellion, 
a soft kind of war 
To be something the world hasn't tasted before.
There is a fire in the fold, 
a grace in the strange.
I am ink on the page 
that refuses to change.

My heart beats to pulse 
that I wear on my sleeve 
I only tell stories that I want to believe .
I'm a bird made of paper, 
a boat made of breath.
I'm dancing on the edge 
of a beautiful depth.
Don't ask for the sun, 
don't ask for the shore.
I've opened a lock 
on an invisible door.

top_comments.author: @verhman
top_comments.text: I worked in the industry as a set designer. I can clearly picture the meeting with the director and the initial drafting, the rough cost estimate for what's in this video: the task of producing it without artificial intelligence would have terrified me, especially given the always-tight deadlines. It would probably have been possible to replicate it, for the most part, without a computer. But the actual production, filming, costumes, casting, and locations would have cost as much as a new Boeing 777.
